name: Artificial root exudate (RE) medium (PMC12222865)
organism_scope: Synthetic community of plant-beneficial rhizosphere bacteria (SynCom4/SynCom5; incl. Cellulosimicrobium cellulans, Pseudomonas stutzeri)
description: Artificial root exudate (RE) medium — a defined medium extracted from Wang et al. (2025). Mapped to BiGG from the paper's stated composition.

provenance.citation: Wang et al. Narrow-spectrum resource-utilizing bacteria drive the stability of synthetic communities through enhancing metabolic interactions. Nature Communications (2025). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-025-61432-7. [PMC12222865]
provenance.notes: Extracted from the primary paper (snippet: RE medium consisted of M9 inorganic salt medium (Sigma-Aldrich M6030) supplemented with sugars (glucose, fructose, sucrose, arabinose, xylose, maltose, and galactose, each at a concentration of 1 mmol). Component names mapped to BiGG (see mapping_confidence); presence-based bounds unless the paper gave exchange bounds; concentration_mM where units allowed. Extraction confidence: high.
provenance.verification_evidence: RE medium consisted of M9 inorganic salt medium (Sigma-Aldrich M6030) supplemented with sugars (glucose, fructose, sucrose, arabinose, xylose, maltose, and galactose, each at a concentration of 1 mmol·L−1), organic acids (succinic, malic, tartaric, oxalic, citric, pyruvic, and malonic, each at a concentration of 0.5 mmol·L−1) and amino acids (glutamic, alanine, threonine, serine, valine, glycine,
provenance.source_identity_evidence: provenance.notes contains 'Extracted from the primary paper'

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
